route_summary: AgentCore Runtime application entrypoint using the official Python SDK decorator, with input contract and local server startup; model/provider logic remains an explicit application integration.
supported_boundary: Python 3.11+, bedrock-agentcore 1.24.2 and Strands Agents 1.16.0, Docker/runtime deployment tooling and buyer AWS account. Hosted preview cannot run this SDK or deploy the runtime; sample handler does not claim model inference.
